name: Lookup Table
description: Look up common ports, Linux exit codes and timestamp formats.

hints.key: Ports accept a number such as 443 or a name such as https; exit codes take a number; timestamp formats take a name such as unix-ms.
hints.output: The data comes from a built-in snapshot; nothing is fetched and no system service list is read.

faq.q: Does an unknown query raise an error?
faq.a: No. When there is no exact match, a list of fuzzy candidates is returned.
It is a snapshot of common ports; a given service may differ, so follow your actual deployment.
